title: A field log in Settings › About, kept on this device only
items: Settings › About now has a Field log: how many times you landed, inspected a building, opened an Inspect tab, used Show me, started and finished a Jaunt, reached a Tour step and chose a Confidence view preset.
It also shows how long the last first inspect took after landing, and how many landings got there within 90 seconds.
The counts stay in this browser. Nothing is sent anywhere, and Clear empties the log.
